name: Gentle Respite draws into memory when the opponent has more influence
notes: Gentle Respite's element is NORM, so no lineage patch is needed. Two extra Dungeon Guide copies are seeded directly into the opponent's hand so their influence (hand + memory count) exceeds ours even after our 3-reserve payment (which moves cards from hand to memory but doesn't change our total influence). The opponent is hardcoded as the target -- there is no target-player choice to make. Without a [Class Bonus] discount, the full 3-reserve cost is paid, then the condition is checked and a card is drawn into memory.

rulesClauses: If target opponent's influence is greater than yours, draw a card into your memory.
